items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 13:162:1
items.html: Hidden Hochma [Hochma Stimaa], and it too is divided into thirteen, etc., since it is the discernment of a brain, certainly it is divided into three brains, etc., and behold they are three HaVaYaHs in the three brains, etc.: This the ARI has already explained above (page 1312, item 39). See there, where he explained these three HaVaYaHs in their fillings and their Nekudot. And see in the Inner Light there.
